blocks.text: Sankara Eye Care Accelerates Enterprise AI Adoption with Claude
Healthcare
Client
Sankara Eye Care, a leading eye care healthcare organization exploring how enterprise AI can support its teams in their everyday work.
Ambition
To move from AI experimentation to practical, responsible and repeatable Claude adoption across teams.
Outcome
Established a structured, demo-led approach to Claude that raised AI awareness and surfaced high-value productivity and developer use cases for broader enterprise adoption.
The Ambition
Sankara Eye Care, a leading eye care healthcare organization exploring how enterprise AI can support its teams in their everyday work.
The Challenge

As organizations continue to explore Generative AI, the key challenge is moving from experimentation to practical, responsible and repeatable adoption across teams. Sankara Eye Care needed a way to help its people understand where Claude could add value in their day-to-day work and to prioritize the use cases most relevant to the business.
The Architectural Blueprint

Sankara Eye Care wanted to explore how enterprise AI could support its teams in their everyday work, while identifying practical use cases that could deliver value across different functions. The objective was to introduce users to Claude, demonstrate its capabilities through real-world scenarios, and identify opportunities for broader adoption across the organization.
Ambition, Realized

The engagement with Sankara Eye Care is helping establish a structured approach to exploring Claude for enterprise productivity and development. Through practical demonstrations and discussions, the teams are identifying the use cases most relevant to their functions and building a roadmap for wider Claude adoption across both business and technology teams.
Key Business Impact
Increased Awareness of Claude and Its Capabilities
Demonstrated Practical Productivity Use Cases with Claude Cowork
Explored Claude Code for Developer Productivity
Identified Opportunities for Broader Enterprise AI Adoption
